posts.subject: More inactive then usual
posts.bodyHtml: Hello, I'm writing this post cause I have to say I'm going to be even more inactive then I'm already am (cause of my pc problems which I might figure out by now) but right now I'm dealing with some hard hitting stuff and it affects my personal life and I really don't feel like going on teamspeak and such, I'll try check forums once a day atleast but I probarly won't come on teamspeak as often as I do. But right now I feel extremly depressed and feel like not doing anything which affects everything with my life such as school and other hobbies like this one. I'm really sorry for my long inactives and if actions must be taken from the higher staff against me then I'll just have to take it then. This is not me crying out for help just me giving the info to everyone in the team. Thank you and hopefully this "thing" get's fixed really soon and everything becomes normal again.

Take your time @WHAT to fix your personal problems and come back to us when everything will be fixed. 🙂


If you need to talk or need help with something, do not hesitate to contact me.

No problem at all!
Personal stuff comes first! I hope you get your things together and if you need help, we got you! 🙂


Stay positive, brother!

it's always a sad thing when someone who you know (even little bit) get to have some problems in his/her life, i experienced a lot of sad moments/times in my life, life was always a hard place for me, it really was, the only thing that healed me at this times in my life was, trying to bring positivity, and just thinking about all the good stuff that i had going on in my life, wasn't easy at the time because you are really just focusing on that 'thing' that is bothering you.
life have down and up and you are on the down side right now, but the lower you go, you enjoy it more when you get back up, trust me on that.




i hope you get well again and join us on the team, for now just take you're time and don't rush anything you do in your life, i did that and i payed a expensive price for it.



good luck
@Mas0n oh please don't give me that bullshit, (really sorry everyone) but don't talk shit behind my back and act like my friend, I got enough problems, I ain't got no time for dealing with you
Way to go @WHAT ... what about ignoring him and telling him personally or not telling him at all? Think about it...

@Thorin Pikachu no right now I need to stand up for myself and others. I don't know shit what I'm going through, and he has no right to act like this. In my world, this is completely disrespecting. Showing everyone that he cares and stuff, for what? He doesn't care about me, and I have proof and serveral people well knowing that. So you think about it. No harm against you tho bro

@WHAT I know that you can have so much bad stuff and I know from Mason it could sound a bit different that he ment it because we know your relation, but that is still no reason to put it like that here... I wish you that you will solve your problems... I really do and I hope you will come back nice and happy as you were. But keep it civile.
